title: [MTR3]Tianjin Metro DKZ7 pack
description: Add a Tianjin Metro Line 9 DKZ7 train.
body:
# 中文

本资源包为Minecraft Transit Railway模组添加了天津轨道交通9号线DKZ7型列车，并添加了基于JavaScript脚本实现的车头终点站显示屏、车内滚动走字屏和车号、LCD。

本资源包提供MTR 3.2和MTR 4.0 **（后期提供）** 两个适配版本。使用MTR3.2需要安装（A）NTE mod，MTR4.0需安装Joban Client Mod.

您可以在事先不通知的情况下将资源包用于服务器使用，但对外发布整合包必须注明来源。

# English
This resource pack adds the Tianjin Rail Transit Line 9 DKZ7 train to the Minecraft Transit Railway mod, along with JavaScript-based front destination displays, interior scrolling text displays, and car numbers, as well as LCD screen.

This resource pack provides two compatible versions: one for MTR 3.2 and one for MTR 4.0 (to be provided later). When using MTR 3.2, the (A) NTE mod is required; for MTR 4.0, the Joban Client Mod is required.

You may use this resource pack on servers without prior notice, but if you redistribute it as part of a modpack, you must credit the source.

# 致谢&AIGC声明

本资源包使用的JavaScript脚本基于Jeffreyg1228的上海地铁风格动态 LCD 追加，并使用了AI工具生成代码。所有代码经过了人工审查。
